Evidence: The Kerala High Court has directed the state government not to make any financial payments to contractors involved in the installation of AI cameras until further orders. This decision was made in response to a PIL alleging corruption and concerns regarding the change from a BOOT model to an annuity model for the project. The court is examining whether this change affects the financial implications for the exchequer (Source 1, Source 2, Source 3).
Justification: The retrieved evidence clearly states that the Kerala High Court has restrained the government from making any financial payments related to the AI camera installation project. This directly contradicts the claim that the court allows the government to make such payments despite the change of model, thus refuting the claim.
